info.description: Sign-in service and the only issuer of tokens: password sign-in, sessions and profiles.
info.title: go-identity API

get.description: The tenant's audit log, newest first. action takes a LIKE pattern such as role.%

The roles copied into each new tenant at creation. Super admin only; 404 in single mode.

post.description: Adds a template copied into tenants created afterwards. Super admin only.

delete.description: Removes a template. Tenants already created keep their copied roles. Super admin only.

404.description: Template not found, or single mode

patch.description: Renames a template or replaces its permissions; affects only tenants created later.

404.description: Template not found, or single mode

get.description: One page of the tenant's roles, ordered by name.

post.description: Adds a role to the tenant. Only permissions the caller holds can be granted.

get.description: One of the tenant's roles with its permissions and version.

delete.description: Deletes a role. A role still assigned needs force=true, which removes the assignments too.

patch.description: Changes a role's name or description. Requires If-Match with the role's version.

put.description: Sets the full list of permissions a role grants. Requires If-Match with the role's version.

get.description: One page of tenants. Super admin only; 404 in single mode.

post.description: Creates a tenant, copies the template roles and invites the first admin. Super admin only.

get.description: One tenant. Super admin only; 404 in single mode.

404.description: Tenant not found, or single mode

patch.description: Renames a tenant or suspends/reactivates it. The default tenant cannot be suspended.

400.description: Invalid body, or the default tenant cannot be suspended

404.description: Tenant not found, or single mode

parameters.name: search

409.description: ALREADY_MEMBER: an active or disabled member

get.description: One member of the tenant with roles, sign-in methods and version.

404.description: Not a member of the tenant

delete.description: Removes the membership and the user's roles in this tenant; the account stays.

get.description: Enabled providers, registration and tenancy mode for the sign-in screen.

Confirms an email address with the token from the verification mail.
Joins the tenant and signs in. password is required only when the account has none.

get.description: What an invite is for: tenant name, masked email, and whether a password is needed.

post.description: Signs in with email and password. Multi mode without a tenant may answer a tenant choice.
Revokes the session of the refresh token. Answers 204 also for a token that no longer works.
Revokes every session of the refresh token's user. Answers 204 also for a token that no longer works.
Sends a reset mail. Answers 202 whatever the address.
Sets a new password with the token from the reset mail.
Exchanges a refresh token for a new token pair (rotation).
Creates an account. Answers 202 whether or not the address already has one.
Trades the caller's token for one in another of their tenants. Multi mode only.
Exchanges a resource service's client credentials for a short-lived token scoped to /v1/internal.

get.description: Live sessions (devices) of the signed-in user.

password.description:
Password is required only when the account has none; otherwise it is
ignored, so an invite never changes an existing password.

display_name.description: DisplayName names a new account; an existing one keeps its own.

tenant.description: Tenant is the tenant slug, used in multi mode.

providers.description:
Providers are the sign-in methods the account has: a password, a
linked Google identity.

tenant.description: Tenant is the tenant slug; required in multi mode, ignored in single.

version.description:
Version changes whenever any role or its permissions change in this
tenant, so a caller can tell the map moved without comparing its
contents.
